en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a two-part stucco building with tiled roofs and a small clock tower. The left wing has arched arcades and a sign marked "Wache." (guardhouse). Several uniformed men stand in front. The right wing has more formal windows and an inscription on the façade above the central windows, with a coat of arms, indicating an official or court building. The scene shows a cobblestone street and a child near the right side of the building.
